test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: The easiest way to solve a issue was to accept the demands of the strikers unconditionally.
The easiest way to solve an issue was to accept a demands of the strikers unconditionally.
The easiest way to solve the issue was to accept the demands of the strikers unconditionally.
An easiest way to solve the issue was to accept an demands of the strikers unconditionally.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Option 3; "The easiest way to solve the issue was to accept the demands of the strikers unconditionally" is grammatically correct.
 
• It correctly uses **“the”** before **“issue”** and **“demands”**, which are specific. The verbs is also correctly in the past tense, aligning with the context of the sentence.
 
• Furthermore, the structure of the sentence including subject-verb agreement is correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 and Option 2 use** "a"** before** "issue" and "demands"**, respectively, which is wrong because in this context these are specific and require the definite article **"the".**
 
• Option 4 is incorrect because** “an”** should only be used before words starting with vowel sounds and here the word **"easiest"** follows **“an” **which does not start with a vowel sound.
